spec.title: VF-018: prices.Prices#total's computed input equations under JBMC and auto --confirm with an 1800 s limit (closes VF-018 with its three sibling jobs)
spec.description: Closes VF-018 (verification/findings.md) when this job and its three siblings pass. The ignored test the_computed_equations_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm in lib/tests/heap.rs failed in job 20261107-083358 because JBMC did not finish prices.Prices#total's computed input equations within the test's own 600 s limit (the default timeout_seconds of the options), where the own checker proves it. By the user's decision 6 of llm-dlc/loops/cleanup.md, the only change is a longer limit: the JBMC tests in heap.rs now take it from JVMCONTRACT_HEAP_TIME_LIMIT (600 s when unset; the own checker's runs keep 600), and this job sets it to 1800. The test and its expectations are unchanged. If it fails, VF-018 is deferred to the user with no second attempt. In 20261107-083358, two runs timed out (prices.Prices#total's computed input equations under --engine jbmc and under auto --confirm) and the rest took about 2 minutes, so the worst case here is about 2 x 30 min + 5 min, plus the release build.
spec.expected: exits 0: the ignored test the_computed_equations_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm passes unchanged with JVMCONTRACT_HEAP_TIME_LIMIT=1800. Under both engines, the three after-build checks Verified and the two defect-build checks Violation, each violation's witness run on a JVM.
